# Google Sans Code

`src/commonMain/composeResources/font/google_sans_code.ttf` is the upright variable font
(`GoogleSansCode[MONO,wght].ttf`) of Google Sans Code v7.001, unmodified, from
https://github.com/googlefonts/googlesans-code. It is licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1
([OFL.txt](OFL.txt)). Collect One uses it as its monospace font (`appMonospaceFontFamily()`).
